opening.text: I feel dizzy, and it feels like the room is spinning around me. It started two days ago, and each episode lasts 20 to 30 minutes. I also have difficulty hearing you in my left ear, sometimes feel unsteady as if I were going to fall down, and I feel nauseated. I have hypertension, diagnosed seven years ago, and I take furosemide and captopril for my blood pressure.
